<P STYLE="text-align: center; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><B>Consent of Independent Auditors</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">We consent to the use in this Registration Statement on Form 10 of UbuyHoldings, Inc. of our report dated April&nbsp;24, 2026, relating to the financial statements of UbuyHoldings, Inc., appearing in this Registration Statement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">We also consent to the reference of our firm under the heading &ldquo;Experts&rdquo; in such Registration Statement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>
